answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 46356 Country: India Title: Bank interest and other in lawful income of sources Question: As I have asked question about the cases in I have been implicated in false cases by my wife and in laws so my question is that can I use the money which is given to me by the bank as interest in my false cases which have been imposed by my wife and in laws? Answer ID: 46356 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1022/800/H=1434) You cannot use it. It may only be used for poor, needy ones. If you spend in a judicial case files against you though it is fake it is unlawful as it is spending on oneself. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
